result.instructions: Tools for Intruder, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which critical issues are open across our targets right now?"; "Show me the occurrences of the latest TLS issue and which hosts they are on."; "Start a scan on our production tag and tell me when it finishes.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Intruder data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run intruder_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run intruder_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run intruder_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. intruder_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: intruder_list_targets
tools.title: List targets
tools.description: List the targets (domains, IPs, cloud accounts) in the Intruder account, with scan status, tags and last scan time. GET /v1/targets/.

address.description: Only the target with this address.

tag_names.description: Only items with these tag names.

target_status.description: Filter by target status, for example live.

offset.description: Zero-based position of the first result (default 0).

tools.name: intruder_add_target
tools.title: Add a target
tools.description: Add one target (a domain, hostname or IP address) to the Intruder account, with optional tags. It adds the target to scope and does not start a scan. POST /v1/targets/.

address.description: The domain, hostname or IP address to add.

tags.description: Tag names to put on the target (max 40 characters each).

tools.name: intruder_list_scans
tools.title: List scans
tools.description: List current and past scans with status, type, target count and timestamps. GET /v1/scans/.

status.description: Filter by scan status, for example in_progress or finished.

scan_type.description: Filter by scan type as the API names it.

tag_names.description: Only items with these tag names.

offset.description: Zero-based position of the first result (default 0).

tools.name: intruder_get_scan
tools.title: Get a scan
tools.description: Get one scan by id, including its status, targets and timestamps. GET /v1/scans/{id}/.

tools.name: intruder_list_scan_schedules
tools.title: List scan schedules
tools.description: List the recurring scan schedules on the account. This list is not paginated. GET /v1/scans/schedules/.

tools.name: intruder_start_scan
tools.title: Start a scan
tools.description: Start a vulnerability scan on chosen targets or tags. Set all_targets to true to scan every target (the API default). Starting a scan uses plan scan capacity. POST /v1/scans/.

tag_names.description: Scan every target with these tag names.

all_targets.description: Set true to scan all targets when no addresses or tags are given.

tools.name: intruder_cancel_scan
tools.title: Cancel a scan
tools.description: Cancel a scan that is in progress. POST /v1/scans/{id}/cancel/.

scan_id.description: The scan id to cancel (from intruder_list_scans).

tools.name: intruder_list_issues
tools.title: List issues
tools.description: List the current security issues across the account, with severity, category and affected counts. Filter by severity, target or tag. GET /v1/issues/.

severity.description: Severity filter as the API expects it (for example critical, high, medium, low).

target_addresses.description: Only items for these target addresses.

tag_names.description: Only items with these tag names.

snoozed.description: Include snoozed issues (default: the API decides).

exclude_deleted_targets.description: Leave out issues on deleted targets.

offset.description: Zero-based position of the first result (default 0).

tools.name: intruder_list_issue_occurrences
tools.title: List issue occurrences
tools.description: List where one issue was found: each occurrence is one affected target, port or path. GET /v1/issues/{issue_id}/occurrences/.

target_addresses.description: Only items for these target addresses.

tag_names.description: Only items with these tag names.

exclude_deleted_targets.description: Leave out occurrences on deleted targets.

offset.description: Zero-based position of the first result (default 0).

tools.name: intruder_get_occurrence_scanner_output
tools.title: Get occurrence scanner output
tools.description: Get the raw scanner output that proves one occurrence of an issue. GET /v1/issues/{issue_id}/occurrences/{occurrence_id}/scanner_output/.

tools.name: intruder_list_occurrence_comments
tools.title: List occurrence comments
tools.description: List the comments on one occurrence of an issue, newest first. GET /v1/issues/{issue_id}/occurrences/{occurrence_id}/comments/.

tools.name: intruder_add_occurrence_comment
tools.title: Add an occurrence comment
tools.description: Add a plain-text comment to one occurrence of an issue, for example a triage note. POST /v1/issues/{issue_id}/occurrences/{occurrence_id}/comments/.

content.description: The comment text (plain text, up to 10,000 characters).

tools.name: intruder_list_issue_targets
tools.title: List targets for an issue
tools.description: List the targets affected by one issue. GET /v1/issues/{issue_id}/targets/.

tools.name: intruder_list_fixed_occurrences
tools.title: List fixed occurrences
tools.description: List occurrences that were fixed (remediated), with the remediation date. Use it to report progress. GET /v1/occurrences/fixed/.

severity.description: Severity filter as the API expects it (for example critical, high, medium, low).

target_addresses.description: Only items for these target addresses.

tag_names.description: Only items with these tag names.

exclude_deleted_targets.description: Leave out occurrences on deleted targets.

offset.description: Zero-based position of the first result (default 0).

tools.name: intruder_list_attack_surface_services
tools.title: List exposed services
tools.description: List the network services (open ports) found on external targets, by address, port and protocol. Limited to the ports in the plan. GET /v1/attack-surface/services/.

protocols.description: Only these protocols, for example tcp or udp.

tag_names.description: Only items with these tag names.

offset.description: Zero-based position of the first result (default 0).

tools.name: intruder_list_licenses
tools.title: List licences
tools.description: List the infrastructure and application licences in use, to check plan capacity. GET /v1/licenses/.

tools.name: intruder_list_tags
tools.title: List tags
tools.description: List the tags on the account. Tags group targets for scans and filters. GET /v1/tags/.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Intruder
prompts.description: What you can do with Intruder here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: review_open_issues_by_severity
prompts.title: Review open issues by severity
prompts.description: List the current security issues, filtered by severity, target or tag. List the targets affected by one issue.

prompts.name: trace_an_issue_to_the_hosts_it_affects
prompts.title: Trace an issue to the hosts it affects
prompts.description: List the occurrences of one issue. Each occurrence is one affected target, port or path. Read the scanner output that proves one occurrence.

prompts.name: report_progress_on_fixed_occurrences
prompts.title: Report progress on fixed occurrences
prompts.description: List the fixed occurrences with their remediation dates, to report progress.

prompts.name: check_exposed_services_and_plan_capacity
prompts.title: Check exposed services and plan capacity
prompts.description: List the network services found on external targets, by address, port and protocol. List the licences to check plan capacity.

prompts.name: add_a_target_and_start_a_scan
prompts.title: Add a target and start a scan
prompts.description: Add a domain, hostname or IP address to scope. Start a scan on chosen targets or tags, then check its status. Adding a target does not start a scan.

prompts.name: add_a_triage_note_to_an_occurrence
prompts.title: Add a triage note to an occurrence
prompts.description: Add a plain-text comment to one occurrence of an issue, such as a triage note. Read the comments already on that occurrence.
